data.long_meaning: The name मारोती (Mārōtī) is derived from Sanskrit words ‘Mārā’ (Maruts) and ‘Tī’ (Mother). This name signifies the mother of the Maruts, a group of wind gods in Hindu mythology. Maruts were believed to bring rain and prosperity, and their mother was revered as the goddess of fertility and abundance. The name मारोती carries the meaning “Mother of Maruts” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose मारोती usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of maruts and live with faith, good character and purpose.
